name: TheRedVillage
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.85). Replaced keyword guess "arbitrary-call".
rootCause: ungated PolygonTRVRouter forwardRequest relays an attacker-supplied upgradeTo through the router's _authorizeUpgrade role on the SeasonService UUPS proxy, installing a malicious implementation that uses the proxy's TRVZooKeeper roles to pull every player's approved WETH and sweep the vault. Lost: 31.426018474517367982 WETH (~$80.7K) swept from TRVZooKeeper on Polygon; 299 players with standing WETH approvals were pulled for 31.350379502001368 WETH and the vault's pre-existing 0.075638972516 WETH was swept with them, reproduced to the wei
